name: Back Stage
source:
Main character is a newcomer music producer. With extraordinary talent he can make ordinary girls into popular idols in a blink of an eye! He practices not only conventional serious study session, but also gives energetic entertainment lessons.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名剛入行的音樂製作人。憑藉非凡的才能，他能在轉眼間把普通女孩培養成當紅偶像！他不僅安排傳統而嚴肅的學習課程，還會提供活潑的演藝訓練。

[來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
